taplo.reason: Replaced by Tombi (TOML toolkit). Use native Tombi binary instead
taplo.replacement: Use tombi from GitHub releases (native Rust binary)

eslint-plugin-arrow-return-style.reason: Incompatible with ESLint 10: it pulls @typescript-eslint/utils@7, which throws "Class extends value undefined" the moment the plugin loads. It was shipped as a dependency but switched off by default, so the breakage stayed invisible
eslint-plugin-arrow-return-style.replacement: None. Arrow body style is taste, and arrow-body-style is already permanently disabled in src/lint-rules/permanent.ts

eslint-plugin-toml.reason: TOML linting/formatting via ESLint is unnecessary, replaced by dedicated tombi and yq-toml tools
eslint-plugin-toml.replacement: Use tombi for formatting/linting and yq-toml for key sorting of TOML files

eslint-plugin-yml.reason: YAML linting/formatting via ESLint is unnecessary, replaced by dedicated yamlfmt and yamllint tools
eslint-plugin-yml.replacement: Use yamlfmt for formatting and yamllint for linting YAML files

husky.reason: Legacy git hooks manager with complex setup, replaced by lefthook
husky.replacement: Use lefthook (faster, simpler configuration, better cross-platform support)

lint-staged.reason: Outdated pre-commit tool, replaced by lefthook's built-in staged file filtering
lint-staged.replacement: Use lefthook with {staged_files} placeholder for running tools on staged files
